title: 雾关必刷题接入生产采集与训练（drill_start cell 族）

environment.archives_location: desktop production roots, read-only; Mac staging copies under artifacts/task235 (deleted after the task)

models.qc_parameters: per-card 1, student-candidates 2, samples 3, verify 9, horizon 2500, min-gap 300, save-candidates 1 on L31-40

mining.excluded: demo_start continuation archives (frame 0 is a restored mid-game state, replay from reset differs); 18 such drills errored during calibration and were dropped
not_covered: digger needs a dedicated underground-state rule; only 1 in-band digger item survived, plus 2 all-1 coverage anchors

production.criterion: all target ids gone/off board, no mower fired, no house breach (scripts/drill_start.py)
production.row_weight: drill_row_weight=3.0 in pvz_recipe defaults; applied at load by the existing DemoRowWeights provenance path, no pack key/column change

caveats: The 2 L36 all-1 coverage anchors teach expert labels but cannot discriminate difficulty; they exist only because L36 digs and its local criterion is weak.
Calibration uses the current teacher (r111 + gpt prior); a later incumbent changes the rates and the bank should be recalibrated.
Drill archives contain only the short horizon, so history-based observation features have no pre-root history; the rows are still valid labels but the first decisions see a short history.
The teacher already succeeds on 49% of the in-band items; these are the learnable gap, not an exam estimate (3 seeds per item, ICC high).
